name: spec-import
title: Read-only external specification import
description: Bounded local external import, constitution-first compatibility, and one approved shared handoff; no source mutation.

completion_intent.rationale: Import ends at one approved shared implementation handoff.

import_compatibility_approval.rationale: Explicit approval binds exact source and constitution hashes plus feature/run selectors.

checkpoint_policy.rationale: Constitution prerequisite precedes compatibility and no native phases are replayed.

stages.title: Bounded external import
stages.prompt: Read only explicitly selected local files; enforce realpath, symlink, size, text, secret, and source immutability bounds; create one snapshot and normalized data.

stages.title: Constitution prerequisite
stages.prompt: Resolve and validate the project constitution before compatibility validation; resume import with the exact binding.

stages.title: Compatibility and supplement
stages.prompt: Evaluate the snapshot against the constitution; use named mapping or generic fallback; produce ready, supplement_required, blocked, or unsupported report and any local supplement.

stages.title: Compatibility approval
stages.prompt: Present exactly one compatibility checkpoint; approval must bind source and constitution hashes and exact explicit feature/run selectors.

stages.title: Imported shared handoff
stages.prompt: After compatibility approval and workflow_advance, call workflow_finalize_import_handoff with only the returned exact feature/run/capability/profile/stage=handoff/epoch and advance_token fields plus bounded evidence; the engine revalidates pinned source artifacts, derives the canonical ImplementationHandoff, writes the nested handoff artifact, renders handoff.md, and sets implementation_ready. Never author handoff content, paths, or approval refs.
